title: Freedom

vibeProfile.oneLine: Atwood, in miniature, on freedom and everything that threatens it.

summary: A slender selection of Margaret Atwood's writing gathered around a single, enormous idea: freedom, and its limits, threats and paradoxes. Ranging across her fiction and non-fiction, these short pieces think about liberty in politics, in relationships and in the imagination, in her characteristically sharp and quietly witty style. A pocket-sized entry point to one of Atwood's central preoccupations, ideal for a single sitting.
whyReadIt: A pocket-sized shot of Atwood on liberty and its limits. Perfect for a single, thoughtful sitting.

funFacts.text: It is part of a series of small books drawing together a writer's work around one theme.
